answer: A single fake is a craft project; a hundred is an industry. Sworn energy assessor registration with energy assessors attestation makes the industry visible: a registration assessors renew after building audits. The zephyr is the factory floor — the supervisors, the stamps, the histories, each needing its own room. Each unit needs its own supervisor and its own paper trail, and the comet is the floor manager: one person coordinating lies full-time, leaving a trail in every ledger they touch. The thread is the pattern across all hundred, which the checker sees at once.
